narrative:
Aktia invests about €19M a year: core banking and the Oracle replacement €7.5M, the life insurance system replacement €4.0M, the Snowflake data and AI platform (DW Phase 2, Cortex) €3.5M, digital channels and the Premium concept €3.0M, and workplace €1.0M.

In the target architecture the CAPEX application takes depreciation and asset values for ongoing investments from CSV today; every new investment shows its depreciation and its effect on the CIR. Depreciation is about €17M a year after the 2024–2025 impairments.

signals.title: FY2025: comparable operating profit €106.0M, CIR 59.0%
signals.excerpt: Operating income €295.8M (NII €138.8M −9%, commissions €124.6M, life insurance €30.6M); comparable opex €173.9M; credit losses €15.8M; ROE 12.8%; CET1 12.6%.
